Brunei Azan

Test builds of Brunei Azan — prayer times and azan alarms for Brunei Darussalam on phone, Wear OS and Android TV. Source: https://github.com/Qoyyuum/brunei-azan

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Qoyyuum/brunei-azan/fdroid/repo
